primary_math_proof: The closed packet has crease boundaries right x=1 and bottom y=0, open stacked edges top/left. In local quarter[0,1]^2, cut endpoints(.5,0),(1,.5) remove the corner triangle at(1,0). Reflections(x,y),(2-x,y),(x,-y),(2-x,-y) give diamond vertices(.5,0),(1,.5),(1.5,0),(1,-.5), strictly interior to original[0,2]×[-1,1]. OnlyE has this hole. D omits the final reflection andC has axis-aligned edges. Original dashedcut, fold/open edges, all fills and choices retained.
